boundaries: Canonical owner domains retain all live identity, state, transaction, salvage, Project/time, Profession, platform and facility authority.
MERA-24 proves orchestration and handoff; it creates no replacement owner engine or duplicate Asset/resource/provenance ledger.
Preview, simulation and analysis remain nonmutating unless an explicit canonical owner operation is separately authorized.
MBES remains blocked until MERA-24 completes_verified and fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation permits its governed successor.
